result.title: Matrix-Game 4.0: Harnessing Video Models for Real-Time Playable Game Worlds
result.comment: Project page, videos, code and models: https://matrix-game-v4-0.github.io/page/
result.summary: Moving from controllable videos to genuinely playable worlds requires persistent world state, executable game rules, and low-latency interaction. We outline a roadmap for the next generation of Matrix-Game that separates game execution from visual generation through an executable game harness, and introduce Matrix-Game 4.0 as the first system built on this design. A lightweight game engine maintains world state and executes interaction rules, a multimodal coding agent translates player ideas into game code and dynamic scene captions, and a renderer based on autoregressive video model transforms engine-rendered low-poly proxies into detailed visuals, conditioned on dynamic captions and memory references. This framework provides continuous guidance for visual generation and enables natural-language creation and modification of scenes and gameplay. Our renderer is trained on aligned low-poly and high-fidelity video pairs and distilled into a causal generator that generates in four-frame chunks with one or two denoising steps. Together with targeted inference optimizations, Matrix-Game 4.0 enables 480p, 60 FPS gameplay on a single NVIDIA RTX5090 with a key-press-to-display latency of 112ms. Single-step generation achieves 83FPS steady-state throughput with 18.2GiB of peak GPU memory usage. With fixed prompts, steady-state throughput also reaches 67FPS on an RTX5080 and 58FPS on an RTX5070Ti. We demonstrate customizable shooter and driving games with engine-enforced mechanics, and release code, model weights, and low-poly game assets to support research and creation of playable game worlds.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出将游戏执行与视觉生成解耦的框架：轻量引擎维护世界状态并执行规则，多模态编码智能体把玩家想法转为游戏代码与动态描述，自回归视频渲染器将低多边形代理转为高清画面，并靠少步因果生成与推理优化在单卡上实现 480p、约 60FPS、112ms 延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 「外部引擎持有状态、渲染器仅做条件生成」与「memory reference 维持长时一致性、少步分块生成的延迟预算」可能为 LVR 中状态承载位置与计算成本分配提供对照线索，但该文不涉及 latent 推理或 VLM 推理诊断，需核查其借鉴价值。
